incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: Service=runtime.generate route=/v1/generate p99 latency breached 5m window > 3s. Pager: pd-ops -> paging Priya.
Priya: acked the page :hand: I'm on it — taking primary triage. Can folks avoid large deploys to generate until we have a handle?
Jared: noted. no deploys. pulling metrics now — is this global or region-specific?
Priya: looks like EU-west is worst. p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~4.6s on eu-west, other regions fine-ish. Customer impact: some real-time customers seeing timeouts on streaming responses.
Sasha: seeing increased queue depth on the sidecar layer in eu-west, and a few GPU util spikes on nodes serving that shard.
Jared: running quick query on wavefront: ```filter(service=runtime AND route="/v1/generate" AND region="eu-west") | rollup(1m,avg,percentile(99))``` getting p99 series, pushing screenshot to thread.
Priya: thanks. Any recent model rollouts or kernel changes?
Sasha: small autoscaler change rolled 12m ago that tweaked cooldown windows, plus a hotpatch to kernel selection staged 8m ago. Could be related.
Jared: checking logs around hotpatch — found repeated `KVCacheEvict: high pressure` traces around 6112229800 onwards and a couple of OOMs on sidecar: ```2026-03-15T09:23:44Z sidecar[pid]: evicting kvcache key=...; pressure=0.87``` and ```OOMKill: process=sidecar mem=14.8G limit=14G```.
Priya: that aligns timeline with the change. Hypothesis: hotpatch or autoscaler tweak caused increased memory churn -> kvcache thrash -> tail latency. Mitigation plan: 1) pause hotpatch rollout, 2) temporarily increase sidecar mem limit for eu-west pool, 3) add prefix cache TTL to reduce eviction, 4) if no improvement, rollback hotpatch.
Jared: I can pause the rollout and bump sidecar memory on the eu-west node pool. Doing step 1 and 2 now. ```kubectl rollout pause deployment/hotpatch-controller -n runtime-prod-eu```
Jared: bumped memlimit on sidecar DaemonSet to 18G for eu-west: ```kubectl patch ds sidecar -n runtime-prod-eu --patch '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"sidecar","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"18Gi"}}}]}}}}'```
Sasha: toggled cache TTL to 30s for route=/v1/generate in eu-west via config service. New TTL will remove aggressive eviction.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by Priya at 6112229999.
Priya: monitoring metrics now. Please post p99 after changes (give it 2 minutes). Also lowering routing fanout to reduce load on hot nodes: set route fanout=2 temporarily.
Jared: fanout set. Querying p99... (30s) p99 dropped from 4.6s -> 2.8s and still trending down. p95 stable at ~1.1s.
Sasha: GPU util on the hot nodes normalized, fewer OOM logs. KV eviction rate dropped 70%.
Priya: good. Customer impact reduced but SLO still burning (we're under threshold but cumulative burn > alert window). I'll leave the page open and will watch for 30m. If stable for 20m, we'll close and post a postmortem owner.
Jared: backing out hotpatch completely to be safe. ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/hotpatch-controller -n runtime-prod-eu```
Sasha: creating a temporary maintenance window in PD to suppress noisy followups for 60m while we stabilize: PD-incident #INC-6112229999 created and linked.
Priya: thanks. Action items captured: - Owner: Priya for incident coordination - Root-candidate: hotpatch + autoscaler cooldown interaction - Short-term: increased sidecar mem, cache TTL, reduced fanout, hotpatch rollback - Long-term: add kvcache pressure circuit-breaker and improve rollout canary for kernel changes
Jared: leaving a note to alert on OOMKill rate per node so we can catch earlier. ```alert: SidecarOOMs rate > 0.5/min for 5m -> pager to eng-infra```
Priya: team, if anything new appears ping @pagerduty or escalate to L2. I'll post a debrief + timeline after 2h. For now keep monitoring; closing PD alert when we sustain 20m at p99 < 2.0s. :eyes: 
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident updated INC-6112229999 status=investigating assigned=Priya.
